items.source: Tell sentinel to start monitoring a new master with the specified RedisNode.getName(), RedisNode.getHost(), RedisNode.getPort(), and RedisServer.getQuorum().
items.translation: 指示哨兵开始监控具有指定RedisNode.getName()、RedisNode.getHost()、RedisNode.getPort()和RedisServer.getQuorum()的新主节点。

items.source: Get a Collection of monitored masters and their state.
items.translation: 获取受监控主节点及其状态的 Collection。

items.source: Force a failover as if the master was not reachable.
items.translation: 强制故障切换，仿佛主节点不可达。

items.source: Show list of replicas for given master.
items.translation: 显示给定主节点的副本列表。

items.source: Collection of RedisServers. Never null.

items.source: Removes given master. The server will no longer be monitored and will no longer be returned by masters().
items.translation: 移除指定的主节点。服务器将不再被监控，也不再会被 masters() 返回。
克里斯托夫·施特罗布，马克·帕卢赫
